simple.meaning: צִפּוֹר (tsippôwr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a little bird (as hopping).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 40 times across Genesis, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Nehemiah, Job, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 7:14. Its contexts include blood, death, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִפּוֹר (H6833).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צִפּוֹר (tsippôwr) / H6833 is traced through Genesis 7:14, Genesis 15:10, Leviticus 14:4, Leviticus 14:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.
